name: InputRichMessageMedia
description: Describes a media element embedded in an outgoing rich message.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the media used in a `tg://photo?id=`, `tg://video?id=`, `tg://document?id=`, or `tg://audio?id=` link. 1-64 characters, only `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-` are allowed.

fields.name: media
fields.rawType: InputMediaAnimation or InputMediaAudio or InputMediaDocument or InputMediaPhoto or InputMediaVideo or InputMediaVoiceNote
fields.description: The media to be sent. Everything except the media itself and its properties is ignored.
